entities.summary: Wilhelm Josef Sachs known as Willy Sachs was a German industrialist and Nazi party member. He served in the SS as an Obersturmbannführer and was appointed as a Wehrwirtschaftsführer, recognizing his company's importance to the war effort. Sachs was awarded the Federal Cross of Merit in 1957 and was an honorary citizen of Schweinfurt, Mainberg and Oberaudorf.
